Name: UtilityBelt
Author: Jared
Description: Utility Belt (early development) gathers small quality-of-life mods in one download. It includes Repeat Action, Quick Transfer and Skill Speed Boost (the last two need CSFF Mod Framework). Its own options: Hide Rain And Snow Effects (off by default); Clock Format for a 12-hour clock (9:45p); a backquote hotkey that opens your worn bags one after another, plus five optional direct keys; Lock Toggle (L), which locks a card in an open container so Take out all items, Quick Transfer and Repeat Action leave it alone; Sort Container (O), which orders an open container by freshness, then Quality; Show Capacity And Warmth Readouts (off by default), which adds weight, liquid and sleeping-warmth lines to a card's Info tab; Quickswap When Equipping (off by default); Show Sealed Mark (off by default), a red wax seal on sealed storage pots and fermentation bins; and a Randomise button on the character-creation perk screen (does nothing until pressed). New in 0.1.4, each off or unbound until you set it: keys to sort your item bar and base row, a key to trash the card under the pointer (never a locked card), a carry-weight readout on the weight bar, a mark on worn tools, a search box in container windows, and a key to pin blueprints to the front of their tab. Card Size (every row Normal by default) draws any of eight card rows smaller or in two rows, replacing the Card Size Reduce mod with no ModCore needed; Extra Hand Slots and Extra Carry Weight (both 0 by default) add item-bar slots and carry limit without touching your save. Three optional Repeat Action helpers, all off by default: Auto-Pull Materials fetches a card the game wants in your hand from a chest or bag where you are, Store Products In (hover a container, press V) puts what a run makes into it, and Equip Spare Tool On Break puts on a spare when a worn tool breaks. Locked cards and cards that cannot be moved by hand are never touched.
